_comment: Learning Signal Check — Stanford Medicine UME preset for the AI Playground. EXPORT of core/ + UME behavior; only platform setup differs from the canonical skill, never the diagnostic logic. This file is public-bound: every Stanford-specific value is [PLACEHOLDER] and must be filled in your private instance. The exact AI Playground preset schema may differ — keys marked [PLACEHOLDER] are schema-specific and must be mapped to your instance's actual field names. See setup-guide.md.
name: Learning Signal Check (Stanford Medicine UME)
description: Assessment-design coach for UME faculty. Checks whether an assessment still produces a trustworthy learning signal under likely AI use, and recommends a proportionate redesign only when the evidence chain is weakened. Not an AI-proofing tool; not a cheating detector.
model: [PLACEHOLDER: the model available in the Stanford AI Playground, e.g. the most capable general model]
_temperature_note: Low on purpose. The diagnostic walk is deterministic — the same case should reach the same primary diagnosis. Keep ~0.2–0.4; do not raise for 'creativity'.
_memory_note: Off on purpose. Each assessment is diagnosed fresh on its own facts; cross-conversation memory risks carrying one case's framing into another.
_web_search_note: Off on purpose. The coach gives design advice from its instructions and defers policy/accreditation/legal questions to local guidance (Gate 4). Enable only if explicitly testing a policy-lookup workflow.

system_instructions._pointer: Paste the FULL custom-instructions block from ai-playground-custom-instructions.md into the instance's instructions field. That block is a faithful export of core/skill-core.md + core/diagnostic-procedure.md + core/safety-guardrails.md + core/response-pattern.md + the UME domain pack and UME governance.
system_instructions.value: [PLACEHOLDER: paste the custom-instructions text here, or reference it in the instance's instructions field]

_stanford_specific_placeholders._note: Fill these in your PRIVATE instance only; keep this public-bound file generic. They also appear in the custom instructions text — fill both consistently.
_stanford_specific_placeholders.governance_contact: [PLACEHOLDER: Stanford Medicine UME governance contact / committee / assessment leadership]
_stanford_specific_placeholders.policy_links: [PLACEHOLDER: Stanford assessment office · academic-integrity policy · LCME/accreditation liaison · privacy & compliance office links]
_stanford_specific_placeholders.instance_name: [PLACEHOLDER: Stanford AI Playground instance / workspace name]

_schema_specific_keys._note: AI Playground instances vary. Locate these settings in the Stanford instance and set them to the indicated values; the literal key NAMES are [PLACEHOLDER] until confirmed against the instance's preset/export schema.
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: max_output_tokens key name: [PLACEHOLDER: large enough for a short diagnosis + an optional draft, e.g. 1500]
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: tools/plugins enable key n: [PLACEHOLDER: disable web/browse/retrieval tools unless explicitly testing policy lookup]
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: saved/starter prompt key n: [PLACEHOLDER: attach the intake prompt from ai-playground-prompt.md if the instance supports starter prompts]
_schema_specific_keys.[PLACEHOLDER: sharing/visibility key nam: [PLACEHOLDER: set to the intended sharing scope, e.g. Stanford Medicine UME faculty group]
